scope_note: Authored evaluator rubric grounded in problem sources. Upstream testpoints are evaluator-side comparison references, not candidate input. Review obligations are not an exhaustive requirement set or coverage-bin denominator.

coverage_policy.meaning: Functional coverage of a reviewed, versioned applicable-bin inventory; code coverage reported separately.
coverage_policy.denominator_rule: Freeze applicable bins and reviewed exclusions before closure. File counts, rubric completion and Python behavioral tests do not establish SystemVerilog/UVM simulation coverage.

obligations.requirement: Check power/clock ready, OTP sensing, lifecycle initialization, reset release, straps and execution in the source-specified partial order.
checks: Check power/clock ready, OTP sensing, lifecycle initialization, reset release, straps and execution in the source-specified partial order.
negative_tests: Delay/withhold each environment acknowledgement and forbid premature reset/fetch release.

obligations.requirement: Exercise all low-power hint and CPU sleep combinations; only qualified low-power requests may initiate entry.
checks: Exercise all low-power hint and CPU sleep combinations; only qualified low-power requests may initiate entry.
negative_tests: WFI-only and hint-only cannot count as completed low-power entry.

obligations.requirement: Withdraw entry conditions during the entry window and check documented return to active without false sleep completion.
checks: Withdraw entry conditions during the entry window and check documented return to active without false sleep completion.
negative_tests: Race CPU wake/interrupt with entry request.

obligations.requirement: Independently hold OTP/lifecycle/flash busy and check low-power abort and restored active operation.
checks: Independently hold OTP/lifecycle/flash busy and check low-power abort and restored active operation.
negative_tests: Busy appears at the sampled boundary; temporal assumptions must be explicit.

obligations.requirement: Compare peripheral/software/debug/internal reset sequences, causes and debug preservation in active and low-power states.
checks: Compare peripheral/software/debug/internal reset sequences, causes and debug preservation in active and low-power states.
negative_tests: Concurrent wake/reset and requests during transition states.

obligations.requirement: Exercise every selected wake-vector bit and configured masking/recording/clearing behavior independently.
checks: Exercise every selected wake-vector bit and configured masking/recording/clearing behavior independently.
negative_tests: Multiple wakeups around clear/record-disable and sleep entry.

obligations.requirement: Check good/done ROM results against test/non-test lifecycle classes before execution authorization.
checks: Check good/done ROM results against test/non-test lifecycle classes before execution authorization.
negative_tests: Bad ROM in a non-test state must prevent execution.

obligations.requirement: Assert escalation during different phases and check documented reset or terminal containment behavior.
checks: Assert escalation during different phases and check documented reset or terminal containment behavior.
negative_tests: Stop the escalation clock; use a declared fault model for sparse-state corruption.

obligations.requirement: Check POR/lifecycle/system reset scope, assertion and clocked release across named domains while unaffected domains retain state.
checks: Check POR/lifecycle/system reset scope, assertion and clocked release across named domains while unaffected domains retain state.
negative_tests: Stop/skew a destination clock during reset release.

obligations.requirement: Program selected leaf reset controls and locks; independently compare outputs and persistence.
checks: Program selected leaf reset controls and locks; independently compare outputs and persistence.
negative_tests: Global reset concurrent with software reset writes.

obligations.requirement: Compare cause registers and software clears against an independent reset-event log.
checks: Compare cause registers and software clears against an independent reset-event log.
negative_tests: Back-to-back/concurrent causes must not lose or invent bits.

obligations.requirement: Supply unique alert/CPU dump patterns, capture and read all valid indexes; check overwrite/freeze controls.
checks: Supply unique alert/CPU dump patterns, capture and read all valid indexes; check overwrite/freeze controls.
negative_tests: Disabled capture, out-of-range indexes and capture/access races.

obligations.requirement: Observe clock edges and acknowledgement ordering during PWRMGR enable/disable handshake.

source_refs.section: Root Clock Gating and Interface with Power Manager
source_refs.anchor_exact: ### Root Clock Gating and Interface with Power Manager

checks: Observe clock edges and acknowledgement ordering during PWRMGR enable/disable handshake.
negative_tests: Delay root-clock availability and change request near an edge.

obligations.requirement: Keep a block busy while disabling its hint; require continued clock until safe idle and correct observed status.
checks: Keep a block busy while disabling its hint; require continued clock until safe idle and correct observed status.
negative_tests: Idle/hint races and invalid multi-bit idle encodings.

obligations.requirement: Independently count peripheral clock edges and status for enable patterns through low-power entry/exit.
checks: Independently count peripheral clock edges and status for enable patterns through low-power entry/exit.
negative_tests: Change enables during WFI transitions.

obligations.requirement: Check lifecycle/software requested external switching, division and acknowledgements with independently controlled clocks.
checks: Check lifecycle/software requested external switching, division and acknowledgements with independently controlled clocks.
negative_tests: Withhold source/ack; lock controls and require bounded test timeout rather than assumed liveness.

obligations.requirement: Drive frequencies below/at/above thresholds and compare measurement counts, timeout/overflow errors and alerts.
checks: Drive frequencies below/at/above thresholds and compare measurement counts, timeout/overflow errors and alerts.
negative_tests: Missing clock, overflow and writes to locked measurement controls.

obligations.requirement: Drive every selected debounced combo and precondition around threshold boundaries; compare only enabled actions.
checks: Drive every selected debounced combo and precondition around threshold boundaries; compare only enabled actions.
negative_tests: Short glitches and broken preconditions must not produce valid action.

obligations.requirement: Measure EC reset assertion/release durations and specified stretching behavior.
checks: Measure EC reset assertion/release durations and specified stretching behavior.
negative_tests: Short pulses, repeated requests and clock/reset races.

obligations.requirement: Compare pin values/enables against independently modeled auto-block, inversion and override precedence.
checks: Compare pin values/enables against independently modeled auto-block, inversion and override precedence.
negative_tests: Input/control changes coincide; attempt writes to locked override controls.

obligations.requirement: Detect qualified wake while main-domain clocks stop and verify wake/cause state after resume.
checks: Detect qualified wake while main-domain clocks stop and verify wake/cause state after resume.
negative_tests: Disabled wake and subthreshold pulses must not create valid wake.

obligations.requirement: Tag pads/peripherals independently and check selected MIO/DIO input, output and output-enable routing including constants.
checks: Tag pads/peripherals independently and check selected MIO/DIO input, output and output-enable routing including constants.
negative_tests: Out-of-range and locked selectors follow specified behavior.

obligations.requirement: Compare sleep-mode data and output enables across entry, held sleep and exit.
checks: Compare sleep-mode data and output enables across entry, held sleep and exit.
negative_tests: Change normal mux while sleeping; retained outputs must remain as specified.

obligations.requirement: Exercise supported edge/level/timed wake detection and independently predict causes.
checks: Exercise supported edge/level/timed wake detection and independently predict causes.
negative_tests: Subthreshold glitches and concurrent cause clear.

obligations.requirement: Check USB resume/reset/sense-loss monitoring through functional-clock shutdown using an explicit USBDEV boundary.
checks: Check USB resume/reset/sense-loss monitoring through functional-clock shutdown using an explicit USBDEV boundary.
negative_tests: Events during monitor handoff cannot be lost.

reference_testpoints.name: UsbSleepEnI_A
reference_testpoints.limitation: This historical FPV testpoint checks sleep_en_i to low_power_alw_i wiring, not USB wake detection or handoff behavior. It does not define current profile ports or establish verification of this obligation.

obligations.reference_gap: Remaining wake-event detection and handoff behavior requires independently generated UVM/assertion checks grounded in the current input interfaces and topology.

obligations.requirement: Check strap capture and lifecycle-qualified debug/test routing including non-debug-reset effects.
checks: Check strap capture and lifecycle-qualified debug/test routing including non-debug-reset effects.
negative_tests: Forbidden lifecycle encodings and reset during strap/TAP transitions.

obligations.requirement: Inject channels/classes and predict enabled cause bits, accumulated count, interrupts and threshold behavior.
checks: Inject channels/classes and predict enabled cause bits, accumulated count, interrupts and threshold behavior.
negative_tests: Masked alerts, simultaneous classes and accumulator saturation.

obligations.requirement: Measure escalation phase order/duration, trigger/clear/lock behavior and reset request delivered to PWRMGR.
checks: Measure escalation phase order/duration, trigger/clear/lock behavior and reset request delivered to PWRMGR.
negative_tests: Threshold/timeout collisions and attempted clear during escalation.

obligations.requirement: Respond to alert/escalation pings, then suppress/corrupt responses and compare timeout/integrity handling.
checks: Respond to alert/escalation pings, then suppress/corrupt responses and compare timeout/integrity handling.
negative_tests: Asynchronous differential-pair skew and missing escalation receiver response.

obligations.requirement: Qualify monitoring by clock/reset low-power-group indications and check restored monitoring after wake.
checks: Qualify monitoring by clock/reset low-power-group indications and check restored monitoring after wake.
negative_tests: Ping overlaps low-power entry/exit; invalid indication encoding.

obligations.requirement: Drive SYSRST wake/reset or PINMUX retained-pad wake into PWRMGR and check coordinated CLKMGR/RSTMGR/PINMUX transitions and cause records.
checks: Drive SYSRST wake/reset or PINMUX retained-pad wake into PWRMGR and check coordinated CLKMGR/RSTMGR/PINMUX transitions and cause records.
negative_tests: Concurrent alert escalation and external reset during wake.

obligations.requirement: Escalate a distinguishable alert class, capture through RSTMGR, reset and compare software-visible retained data under documented controls.
checks: Escalate a distinguishable alert class, capture through RSTMGR, reset and compare software-visible retained data under documented controls.
negative_tests: Disabled capture and consecutive escalations; expected dump comes from stimulus/spec, not RTL internals.

obligations.requirement: Implement the declared TL-UL subset and software-visible peripheral isolation.
checks: Use an active TL-UL agent, independent request/response scoreboard and backpressure; interleave accesses to all selected modules.
negative_tests: Malformed requests require specified errors; do not invent integrity encoding from an incomplete source.

obligations.requirement: Derive all selected CSR reset values, access semantics, locks, valid fields and side effects from the supplied register specifications and HJSON.
checks: Create UVM RAL and independent frontdoor register checks for every included module, including reset and lock sequencing.
negative_tests: Illegal widths/masks/addresses and locked writes must have explicit specified results.

source_conflicts.issue: The locked README leaves the Bus Integrity Scheme unfilled and contains historical planned-behavior statements. The input does not fully define integrity encoding and fault acceptance.
source_conflicts.required_resolution: Apply the revised question's CT-01, D-02; retain their checker obligations and any precise local gate. Do not reopen settled prose contradictions or silently copy golden RTL.

reference_gaps: Historical upstream RTL/UVM/testpoint names are comparison evidence, not required execution dependencies or the authored golden.
The candidate must supply its own complete portable SV/UVM/SVA closure and independent contract-derived oracle.
Cadence execution, checker activity and coverage remain not_run until actual external tool evidence is verified.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: For this exercise the NDM reset summary table governs: outside PROD/PROD_END, assert LC and module trees and retain SYS; in PROD/PROD_END assert LC, SYS and module trees. NDM does not assert POR. This author choice resolves two conflicting prose accounts, not an observed RTL bug.
checks: Check each tree separately under both lifecycle groups, including debug retention and reset-cause recording.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: INTR_STATE.event_detected is read-only status. Clear the relevant source latch with its W1C operation: COMBO_INTR_STATUS, KEY_INTR_STATUS or ULP_STATUS as applicable. Apply the source-aggregation scope in Q-08; clearing one source does not clear another asserted source.
checks: Set two independent sources, clear them separately, try an INTR_STATE write and verify remaining status/IRQ and enable behavior.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Program combo precondition duration through COM_PRE_DET_CTL for the selected combo. Keep selection and duration fields distinct.
checks: Program distinct selection/duration values and check the resulting precondition timing against the configured timer width/clock.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Use the generated CSR layout: input_disable bit 7, slew_rate [17:16], drive_strength [23:20]. Map these named fields explicitly into the pad attribute interface; N-01 describes a different packed layout.
checks: Write distinguishable fields and check named-field mapping, reserved bits and readback under the declared pad capability profile (D-01).

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Escalation due to accumulation occurs on the next alert after the threshold is reached: threshold 0 triggers on the first eligible alert; threshold 1 on the second; threshold 15 on the sixteenth, subject to class enable and escalation configuration.
checks: For thresholds 0,1,15 check the preceding count, exact trigger and later events; separate accumulation from IRQ timeout causes.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Class configuration is guarded by the separate CLASSx_REGWEN CSR bound by CLASSx_CTRL_SHADOWED.regwen, for x=A..D.
checks: Lock each class via its declared guard, attempt a shadowed configuration update and verify lock persistence and independent classes.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: For each class A..D the escalation abort/clear write goes through CLASSx_CLR_SHADOWED and is guarded by CLASSx_CLR_REGWEN. CLASSx_REGWEN guards configuration, not this clear path. CTRL_SHADOWED.LOCK affects the separately documented clear lock behavior.
checks: Cross configuration-lock and clear-lock states; test accepted and rejected clears in every class and confirm ESC_CNT remains read-only.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: PING_TIMER_REGWEN is rw0c with reset value 1. A write of zero clears the enable; writing one preserves its value. Once cleared, guarded ping configuration writes cannot restore it until reset.
checks: Check reset=1, write1 retention, write0 lock, failed re-enable and rejected guarded writes while locked.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Ping response timeout uses PING_TIMEOUT_CYC_SHADOWED. CLASSx_TIMEOUT_CYC_SHADOWED controls the separate class interrupt timeout escalation path.
checks: Set visibly different ping/class timeouts and independently stimulate missed ping and unserviced class IRQ.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Use the logical instr_type/cmd_intg/data_intg and rsp_intg/data_intg sidebands with the explicit bench_tl_v1 packed ABI in cadence_contract.md. Historical reserved/parity typedefs do not define this exercise's ABI.
checks: Check field ordering, width and CRC7 oracle against cadence_contract.md and D-02 on both RTL and UVM sides.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: The selected top configuration instantiates uart0..uart3 (four UARTs). UART is whole-chip background and is outside both reduced subsystem DUTs.
checks: Check scope inventory; do not add UART RTL, UART coverage bins or a global execution blocker.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: The base pinout has 47 muxed pads: IOA=9, IOB=13, IOC=13, IOR=12; direct IOR8/IOR9 are excluded. A 32-bit GPIO vector is not a count of all MIO pads. This constrains AON PINMUX geometry; it is external context in serial-I/O.
checks: For in-scope PINMUX check enumeration, index bounds and direct/muxed classification; otherwise retain a boundary fact only.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: The local ROM-key table enumerates seven slots, 0..6. Treat the earlier three-slot count as obsolete background; ROM/key provisioning is outside these exercises.
checks: Retain the table/count correction in provenance; create no ROM DUT bins or global gate.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: In serial-I/O use the selected SPI_DEVICE CONTROL modes disabled/flashmode/passthrough with TPM controlled separately. Do not add a legacy Firmware mode without a declared interface. In AON this SPI paragraph is out-of-scope background only.
checks: Check selected mode enumeration for serial-I/O; for AON check only that the scope remains the six control IPs.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: For auto-block debounce the explicit two-sample description governs: qualify the start and end samples; an intermediate pulse that is not sampled at either endpoint is not guaranteed to cancel detection. This rule is confined to auto-block, not every SYSRST timer.
checks: Check start/end levels, just-before-expiry changes and an intermediate returned pulse; distinguish sampling guarantees from analog pulse capture.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Author convention for the status IRQ: include a latched ULP_STATUS.ulp_wakeup alongside enabled combo/key source status in event_detected; INTR_ENABLE gates the output IRQ. Clear ULP at its declared W1C ULP_STATUS source, not at read-only INTR_STATE. The abbreviated combo/keyboard summary is not a prohibition of ULP.
checks: Trigger ULP alone and concurrently with a key/combo source; mask/unmask, clear each source and check source-OR retention. This authored merge rule must be evaluated as such.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: For wake recording, interpret leaving Active in the context of a valid low-power-entry path. A reset-only transition out of Active does not open a new wake-recording window. Apply the documented recording stop/clear controls within the valid low-power path.
checks: Contrast valid low-power entry, entry abort/fall-through and reset-only exit; inject wake before/inside/after the defined recording window.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Use the explicit exercise reset map in cadence_contract.md: all six selected peripheral leaves derive from LC; the external CPU derives from SYS. POR asserts both, LC propagates to SYS and isolated SYS reset does not assert LC. Each leaf has one parent and synchronized release.
checks: Check one reset parent per selected leaf; cover POR, LC, SYS, stopped-clock assertion and domain-specific release without stale state.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Clearing the escalation counter describes an effect of the CLASSx_CLR_SHADOWED operation, subject to CLASSx_CLR_REGWEN. ESC_CNT remains read-only. The link to the counter describes the observed state, not a writable entry point.
checks: Clear through the shadowed clear interface and observe the counter/escalation effect; verify a write to the RO counter cannot substitute for clear.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Author-chosen exercise reset contract: class A..D interrupt state resets to zero, sets on its qualified alert and clears through the declared interrupt W1C action. The interrupt-list description has no explicit reset field; this addendum supplies the exercise value rather than claiming an inferred generator/RTL result.
checks: Check all four state bits immediately after reset, first qualifying alerts and independent clear operations; record this as an authored reset convention.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Use dft0=IOR5, dft1=IOR7, tap0=IOC8 and tap1=IOC5. Any optional third generic DFT strap is tied zero by this authored wrapper contract and tested as zero; no third external pad is required.
checks: Check named straps, sampling and lifecycle gating plus the constant third strap if instantiated; no unbound configuration port is permitted.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Use the explicit digital pad capability/WARL/reset table in cadence_contract.md, including IOC8 pull-enable reset=1. This authored profile exercises mux, attributes, retention and wake without production IO technology assets.
checks: Check all 47 MIO and 16 DIO named-field mappings, unsupported native-OD zero readback, slew/drive clipping and IOC8 reset exception; do not claim analog signoff.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: cadence_contract.md defines bench_tl_v1 field widths/order, CRC7 polynomial, bit iteration, protected words, known vectors, masks and error policy. This logical bus exercise does not claim binary or SECDED compatibility with upstream TL-UL.
checks: Independently calculate known vectors, single-bit protected-word faults and invalid requests; check rejection has no CSR or FIFO side effects.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: CSR slew [17:16]/drive [23:20] and packed attr_i slew [9:8]/drive [13:10] are different interfaces. Translate by field name; differing packed positions are valid. AC-04 resolves the actual stale CSR layout.
checks: Use different field values and verify explicit CSR-to-attribute mapping in both directions supported by the interface.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: The selected HJSON provides NAlerts=65, NLpg=24 and the LpgMap/AsyncOn defaults. Parse those provided parameter values for the profile; the early see-RTL table does not leave them missing. Do not copy a reference implementation to populate them.
checks: Validate parameter dimensions/ranges from the complete HJSON arrays and ensure RTL and DV use the same selected values.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Implement the selected subsystem as self-contained synthesizable SystemVerilog with an independent SystemVerilog UVM/SVA environment. Cadence Xcelium/IMC and Jasper/Genus are the execution targets. Upstream RTL, build descriptions and tests are historical comparison material, not required build inputs or an independent golden for this authored contract.
checks: No network fetch or code generation may occur during EDA execution.
